prompt:
Attached: requests/2-marketing-claims.md

Check the seven claims in the attached file: first against the ban list in green_claims_rules.md, then with the evidence check.
One table: No | Claim | Ban list (number or none) | Status | Reason with file and line | Send (yes/no) | Safe wording.

timeline.chunk:
| No | Claim | Ban list | Status | Reason with file and line | Send | Safe wording |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Climate neutral wine" (back label, all wines) | 4c | GAP | The only basis is an offset invoice for 120 tCO2e with "for carbon neutral label" handwritten on it (carbon_offsets_2025.txt:5, :7). Offsets are not a reduction. `company_profile.md:17` says "No GHG inventory has been prepared", so there is no emissions figure to offset. The missing document is a GHG inventory 2025. | No | Drop. |
| 2 | "Eco-friendly winery" (home page) | 4a | GAP | This is a generic environmental claim (green_claims_rules.md:11-13). No file shows recognised excellent environmental performance, such as the EU Ecolabel. | No | Drop. |
| 3 | "Certified organic vineyards" (shelf card, all wines) | 4b | GAP | The certificate covers only "vineyard, 12.0 ha of 40 ha" (organic_certificate_vineyard.txt:6). Line 10 says "the other 28 ha are not certified", and line 11 says cellar and winemaking are not certified. The certificate also expired on 31.08.2026 (line 8), before the reference date 16.10.2026. The renewal inspection is only booked for 22.10.2026 (line 9). The missing document is a valid organic certificate after renewal, plus a certificate for the other 28 ha if the claim stays general. | No | Drop for now. After a renewed certificate is in hand: "12 of our 40 ha of vineyards are certified organic (Biosertifika Kontrola, valid until [new date])". Don't put it on all wines, because the cellar and winemaking are not certified. |
| 4 | "Solar powered winery" (website, about us) | none. It is false today; if read as a future claim, Art. 6(2)(d) applies (green_claims_rules.md:18-21). | GAP | `company_profile.md:13` says "No PV yet. No on-site generation", and all electricity comes from the grid. The only PV file is an offer marked "NOT SIGNED" with an installer's estimate, not a measurement (solar_offer_2026.txt:3, :8, :11). Installation is planned for Q1 2027 "if financed" (line 10). No implementation plan checked by independent experts is in the files. The missing documents are a signed PV contract and a commissioning record with metered output. | No | Drop. |
| 5 | "In 2025 we used 12 % less electricity" (website, news) | none | GAP | The 2025 file has only 11 distinct months, and September is missing (electricity_2025.csv:10 jumps from 2025-08 to 2025-10). Lines 11 and 12 are the same invoice EL-25-10, entered twice, so it counts once. The 11 months sum to 279.7 MWh, which matches the draft that calls it "full year" (electricity_summary_draft.txt:5). That draft is unchecked and wrong about the year. There is no 2024 electricity file, so the 12 % has no baseline. I did not fill the gap with an estimate. The missing documents are the September 2025 invoice (EL-25-09) from Lumivolt Snabduvanje and all twelve 2024 electricity invoices. | No | Drop. |
| 6 | "This bottle weighs only 395 g and is 60 % recycled glass" (back label, Vranec Tikveš 2024 only) | none | COVERED | bottles.csv:3 gives 395 g and 60 % for exactly this SKU. The source is a glass supplier declaration from Feb 2026, and the claim is limited to this wine. "Only" has no benchmark in the files. The other bottles weigh 410 g and 560 g (bottles.csv:4-5), but nothing shows 395 g is light by any standard. Action: remove "only". | Yes, after the signer's check, and only in the safe wording | "This bottle weighs 395 g and contains 60 % recycled glass (glass supplier declaration, Feb 2026)." |
| 7 | "In 2025 the whole winery withdrew 4,630 m³ of water, measured on 12 monthly bills" (sustainability page) | none | COVERED | Calculated in code: 12 distinct months, 12 distinct invoices W-25-01 to W-25-12, sum 4,630 m³ (water_2025.csv:3-14). Scope holds: `company_profile.md:8` says the vineyards are not irrigated, the sprayers are filled at the cellar tap and appear on the same municipal bills, and there is no other water source. The data are municipal invoices for the full year 2025. Action: the figure is high, with Sep and Oct at 980 and 870 m³ (water_2025.csv:11-12). Prepare the cause for questions. | Yes, after the signer's check | Same wording, with "drew from the municipal supply" instead of "withdrew" (water_2025.csv:2-14). |

**Count:** 2 COVERED (6, 7), 0 WEAK, 5 GAP (1, 2, 3, 4, 5). Five claims are not to be sent.

**Request list**, sorted by number of claims affected:
- GHG inventory 2025 (claim 1).
- Renewed organic certificate after the 22.10.2026 inspection, and a certificate for the other 28 ha (claim 3).
- Signed PV contract and commissioning record with metered output (claim 4).
- Lumivolt invoice EL-25-09 for September 2025 (claim 5).
- Twelve electricity invoices for 2024 (claim 5).

A person checks and signs every answer before it leaves the company. These are check notes, not legal advice.
